title: Your Dream Shall Never Dawn Again
physical_identity: A nigh-perfect replica of Earth in which the entrant wakes in their old home; subtle inconsistencies grow over time; narrated through a first-person beach scene.
scale_topology: Earth-scale replica, outdoors/indoors; extent beyond Earth unknown; narrative beach shown.
anomalies: animals briefly show too little or too much skin
lighting_sound: Narrative: wind and sea heard yet quiet; sun slightly off-position, clouds too fast; sound mismatches waves.

entrances.quote: entirely inaccessible, except for unlocked doors found in Level 2

exits.method: say I'm ready to go back, fall unconscious
exits.quote: invariably causes you to fall unconscious and reawaken in Level 0

signature_mechanic: A near-perfect Earth home whose small wrongnesses grow with time until you ask to go back to Level 0.
do_not: spawn hounds, fires or faceless things
conflicts_notes: Info box lists High Entity Count but article names no entity. Narrative interleaves headings; Level 100 and 102 appear in link list without visible use.

key_quotes.quote: you awaken within your home from before entering the Backrooms
